# GSAP 3.15.0

Official browser distributions vendored for the corporate landing only:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Copyright 2026 GreenSock. The original license headers are retained in both files.
License and terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/

These files are loaded with `defer` on `index.html`. No global smooth-scroll
or scroll normalization is enabled. Without the library, all product controls,
links, static content and native sticky layouts still work.
